nodes.description: address public owner; privileged address set in constructor from msg.sender
mapping(address => uint) public withdrawals; pending balances per player
uint round; current round index, incremented inside userRegister
mapping(uint => address[]) participants; players per round
constructor(): sets owner, round=1 and pushes owner into participants[1]
ownerWithdraw(uint amount) external whenOwner: transfers contract balance to owner
ownerDestroy() external whenOwner: selfdestructs the contract to owner
publicGetRound() view returns current round
publicGetParticipants(uint index) view returns participant count of a round
publicGetParticipant(uint index, uint participant) view returns an address
publicGetBalance(address player) view returns withdrawals[player]
userWithdraw(): zeroes caller balance then transfers it (checks-effects-interactions)
userRegister() payable: fixed 105 finney entry, pseudo-random reward branch based on blockhash
msg.sender: attacker controlled caller used as owner, participant and payout target
owner.transfer(amount): external ETH send in ownerWithdraw
selfdestruct(owner): irreversible destruction of the contract
msg.sender.transfer(amount): external ETH send to an untrusted caller in userWithdraw
withdrawals[participants[round][0]] += reward / withdrawals[msg.sender] += reward: unchecked uint arithmetic
round++: unchecked uint increment of the round counter
amount parameter of ownerWithdraw
index parameter of publicGetParticipants
index parameter of publicGetParticipant
participant parameter of publicGetParticipant
player parameter of publicGetBalance
local amount copied from withdrawals[msg.sender] before transfer
local reward = 100 finney credited to the winner
local random seed derived from blockhash(block.number-1) and participant data
